title: Add Phase 1 change-control scaffolding
summary: Add lightweight Phase 1 change-control folders, version tracking, JSON packet documentation, starter packet, validation tooling, and a generated human-readable index.
reason: Centralized change tracking gives future software versions, bug fixes, and release notes a consistent source of reference without changing runtime media-processing behavior.
behavior_before: The repository did not have the Phase 1 centralized change-control scaffolding requested for software version, bug-fix, and release-note tracking.
behavior_after: The repository has Phase 1 change-control scaffolding, standalone validation/index scripts, a current development version file, and one completed starter change packet.
rollback_plan: The scaffolding can be removed if the project decides not to use centralized change control.
notes: Phase 1 intentionally does not add runtime audit tables, UI diagnostics, job-run tracking, or release bundling.
